title: Infinitely Many Elliptic Curves of Exact Ranks Five, Six, and Seven
summary: We prove that for each $r\in\{5,6,7\}$, there exist infinitely many elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}$, pairwise nonisomorphic over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$, whose Mordell–Weil rank over $\mathbb{Q}$ is exactly $r$. Zywina recently proved the analogous statement for $0\le r\le 4$ over every number field, and our proof follows his strategy. For each $r$, we give an explicit pair of $2$-isogenous elliptic curves whose discriminants are, up to constants, products of powers of twelve binary linear forms in two integer parameters.
